release.name: Zero-shot transfer to deeper circuits and stronger noise (rule 2026-10-06)
release.body:
Fits and logs of the frozen rule `docs/frozen-rules/2026-10-06-shift-transfer.md` (pushed as 24a2cbe before any fit): zero-shot transfer of the descriptor ladder's fitted models to deeper circuits (S4, depth 3 to 6) and stronger noise (S2, L1 and L3 to L4), at rungs R0, N3, R4, and R5 on dataset seeds 101, 211, and 307.

Asset `shift-transfer-fits-v1.tar.xz` (34,755,064 bytes; SHA-256 `29f2a383aaee17c6f0c624adaadf374cb217d9df314192b5f144614fe7be163c`) holds the 960 fits with selected and per-candidate predictions, the N3 coupling-noise tables, the R4 encoder caches, and the fit, generation, and run logs. Every fit equals the archived S0 ladder fit of the same key, rung, arm, and learner seed bit for bit on its validation predictions.

The analyses, preconditions, and results README are in `artifacts/descriptor-information/shift-transfer/`. The shifted datasets regenerate from the rule and `tools/shift_transfer.py generate`; their dataset hashes are recorded in `prepare.json`.

release.name: Exact labels, Bayes oracle, and pooling (rule 2026-10-06)
release.body:
Outputs of the frozen rule `docs/frozen-rules/2026-10-06-round9-follow-ups.md` (pushed at 82aaaf6 before any governed run); results committed at 87870da.

Assets:
- `mlqem-exact-fits-v1.tar.xz`: ML-QEM refits with the exact coupling, basis, and step count added (Part B, all settings, models, arms, and learner seeds), and the primary-cell refits trained on exact labels (two descriptor variants).
- `round9-run-logs-v1.tar.xz`: the local run log of Parts A to D and the logs of the ten Q-LEAR O2 fits.

SHA-256 values are in `artifacts/mlqem-own-data/round9/release-asset-sha256.txt`. The exact labels, gate, analyses, oracle and pooling outputs, O2 predictions, and field reports are in the repository at this tag. ML-QEM data (Apache-2.0) appear only in derived form.

release.name: Confirmation on new seeds, crossed follow-ups, and ML-QEM on its own data v1
release.body:
The fits and datasets of three rules committed at `b04f49b` before any dataset or fit they govern, as reported in the QEMScore paper (the new-seed confirmation, the crossed follow-ups, and Experiment 4). The analyses, predictions, scores, logs, and the scripts as run are in `artifacts/descriptor-information/round8/` and `artifacts/mlqem-own-data/` at this tag; each README gives the commands.

This tag points at `0152dd5`, the commit that added those results.

| Asset | Bytes | SHA-256 | Files |
|---|---:|---|---:|
| `descriptor-information-fresh-v1.tar.xz` | 1,309,808,828 | `1bfcdb1c46938013cbb9d743f61c2e441aceb17dbcced5e9d0f6fb9dcb115e15` | 177,906 |
| `descriptor-information-crossed-follow-ups-v1.tar.xz` | 726,032,300 | `e341be45e244f90fa14ae524281f577479e2a6aaaef135894c12cbcb32e615c2` | 22,074 |
| `mlqem-own-data-v1.tar.gz` | 43,676,096 | `fc6303e3186523d889b81754a0a09f929d2b91e36496830ec9c328c172a343fc` | 438 fits and encoded matrices |

- `descriptor-information-fresh-v1`: the new dataset seeds 401, 503, and 607 at seven shot levels (generated on macOS after the rule was pushed), every level's prepared caches and cache records, every fit of both candidate sets with per-candidate predictions, the predictions file written before any fit of F or P, the generation reports with the 141,367-file hash list, and the DeltaAI run log. Rule `docs/frozen-rules/2026-10-04-fresh-confirmation.md`.
- `descriptor-information-crossed-follow-ups-v1`: every fit of parts B (stronger candidates at six shot levels), C (early-stopped MLP), D (learner seeds 21 to 40), and G (training sizes 40 to 320) with per-candidate predictions, their analyses, and the DeltaAI run log. Part G's 640-circuit reference fits are included as files (copies of the shot-sweep and strong-learner fits of release `descriptor-information-v1`). Parts E and H fit nothing; their outputs are in the repository. Rule `docs/frozen-rules/2026-10-04-crossed-follow-ups.md`.
- `mlqem-own-data-v1`: the 438 fits (predictions and records) of the capacity-matched control on ML-QEM's own simulated data, and the encoded feature matrices with the SHA-256 of their inputs. The ML-QEM data are not redistributed; `qiskit-community/ml-qem` at commit `b1eccf8` and `reanalysis/mlqem/upstream_data_sha256.json` identify them. Rule `docs/frozen-rules/2026-10-04-mlqem-own-data.md`.

```bash
curl -L -O https://github.com/yzhao062/QEMScore/releases/download/confirmation-v1/descriptor-information-fresh-v1.tar.xz
shasum -a 256 descriptor-information-fresh-v1.tar.xz
tar -xJf descriptor-information-fresh-v1.tar.xz
```

release.name: Descriptor-information experiment v1
release.body:
The fits of the descriptor-information experiment and its three follow-ups reported in the QEMScore paper (Experiment 3 and Appendix O). The original rule was frozen before its new-rung and new-dataset fits and reused earlier R0 fits; each follow-up rule was committed before its fits. The rule and the commit that froze it are listed per asset. The analyses, summaries, and post hoc records that read these fits are in `artifacts/descriptor-information/` at this tag, and `artifacts/descriptor-information/README.md` gives every command.

This tag points at `431d101`. Its `artifacts/descriptor-information/posthoc-stacking-pins.json` records, read directly from these four archives, the SHA-256 of each archive and of the 13,200 fit files the post hoc stacking reads.

| Asset | Bytes | SHA-256 | Files |
|---|---:|---|---:|
| `descriptor-information-v1.tar.xz` | 89,990,540 | `9cf19a499122cdff92560333cb2a91b2fcdd098ad8fe0cb95e166f7d186dfa57` | 5,052 |
| `descriptor-information-strength-v1.tar.xz` | 99,746,872 | `d9bc11b4eed70d90f7b3c605c1b1eb3c9656d15fbc83b2c20fe7511a7bdae170` | 5,004 |
| `descriptor-information-strong-learners-v1.tar.xz` | 236,818,824 | `80fcccc657fafcfe68d55a899cf5008977c2e6e7e0994cffadb4e71a32d04643` | 8,797 |
| `descriptor-information-shot-sweep-v1.tar.xz` | 409,030,636 | `d39969f21e77e4ab33a1daaa7b8daedf4b93cb9753c569d575af0ec631971b16` | 151,688 |

- `descriptor-information-v1`: every fit of the original experiment (Parts A and B and the near-Clifford rungs, learner seeds 1 to 20, with per-candidate predictions) and the slim cached test items the analyses read. Rule `docs/frozen-rules/2026-10-02-descriptor-information.md`, frozen at `4c95174`; records added at `9b8c727`.
- `descriptor-information-strength-v1`: the strength-indicator rerun, in which every arm also reads the noise strength. Fits only; it reads the caches of `descriptor-information-v1`. Rule `docs/frozen-rules/2026-10-03-strength-indicator.md`, frozen at `f24a482`.
- `descriptor-information-strong-learners-v1`: the strong-learner rerun (a tuned boosted tree and, at Part A rungs with couplings, a ridge-regularized coupling polynomial join the candidates), Part A and Part B fits, the derived same-platform baseline fits, and the run log. Rule `docs/frozen-rules/2026-10-03-strong-learners.md`, frozen at `832ec36`.
- `descriptor-information-shot-sweep-v1`: the shot-count sweep at seven levels (256 to 131,072 shots and the exact noisy expectation): each level's datasets with manifests and counts sidecars, each level's fits and caches at rungs R0, N1, N2, and R5, and the run reports and log. Rule `docs/frozen-rules/2026-10-03-shot-sweep.md`, frozen at `479a9a0`.

Results of the two follow-ups run on DeltaAI were committed at `6a3dc4e`; the post hoc reporting checks (stacking increment, validation-error-scale ceiling, joint bands, and the pins) at `431d101`.

```bash
curl -L -O https://github.com/yzhao062/QEMScore/releases/download/descriptor-information-v1/descriptor-information-v1.tar.xz
shasum -a 256 descriptor-information-v1.tar.xz
tar -xJf descriptor-information-v1.tar.xz
```

release.name: Campaign archive v1
release.body:
The outputs of the frozen controlled campaign reported in the QEM-Bench paper.

The campaign ran on 2026-09-06 at code revision `22fb3fd`. This tag points at
`f0f125b`, which is that revision plus the two commits adding this archive's
manifest and checksums; no library code differs between them. Its design was frozen before execution under manifest
SHA-256 `060a303e646ca460332a1b2737efa943496badb9dc2f0b356a92cbce707d24ed`, and
`report.json` records `design_frozen`, `freeze_verified`, `fit_bindings_verified`,
`audit_complete` and `fitted_from_a_clean_tree`, all true.

| | |
|---|---|
| Asset | `campaign-archive-v1.tar.gz`, 62,575,902 bytes |
| Asset SHA-256 | `62f1ef1875eaf54100c78fe26164b31d62b5efecfb4740e22a4e2a3c313bf918` |
| Extracts to | 67 files, 277,466,583 bytes |
| Tree fingerprint | `c3b79a0766c1d48117995826a2ee48a1f0b2a1955931f314a9d298dbc9611821` |

Contents: the campaign report, tables, audit and frozen manifest; per-setting
rosters carrying every rostered method's untouched-test predictions, per-cell
error metrics and circuit-evaluation ledger; per-setting records carrying role
assignments, counts, selected configurations and predictions; the fit bindings;
and each setting's dataset manifest. Twelve settings: two regimes by three seeds
by two training sizes.

The generated item streams and sidecars are excluded at 771 MB. The deterministic
generators in this repository reproduce them from the recorded seed and
dependency lock, and `report.json` carries the twelve dataset hashes a
regeneration must match.

To verify:

```
sha256sum campaign-archive-v1.tar.gz
tar -xzf campaign-archive-v1.tar.gz
cd campaign-archive-v1 && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt
```

All 67 lines report `OK`. `campaign-archive/` in the repository carries the same
manifest and checksum list, so the archive can be checked against a copy that
travels in git rather than one that travels beside the download.

The circuit-evaluation ledger counts in each roster entry are each method's own
declaration and are audited nowhere; read them as declared cost rather than
measured cost. `MANIFEST.md` states the archive's limits in full.
